directions.lh-311:
i. Stairs-1: Turn left and walk to the top of the corridor; LH-311 is on your left, LH-312 is on the opposite side.
ii. Stairs-2: Walk straight north all the way to the top; LH-311 is on your left at the far end.
iii. LIFT: Turn left and walk north to the top of the corridor; LH-311 is on your left.
directions.lh-312:
i. Stairs-1: Turn left and walk to the top of the corridor; LH-312 is on your right, LH-311 is on the opposite side.
ii. Stairs-2: Walk straight north all the way to the top; LH-312 is on your right at the far end.
iii. LIFT: Turn left and walk north to the top; LH-312 is on your right.
directions.lh-309:
i. Stairs-1: Turn left and walk north a short distance; LH-309 is on your left, just below LH-311.
ii. Stairs-2: Walk straight north; LH-309 is on your left in the upper-middle section of the corridor.
iii. LIFT: Turn left and walk north; LH-309 is on your left, a few steps up from the Lift.
directions.lh-310:
i. Stairs-1: Turn right; LH-310 is immediately on your right just outside the Stairs-1 exit.
ii. Stairs-2: Walk north and then turn right at the mid-floor corridor; LH-310 is on your right.
iii. LIFT: Turn right; LH-310 is directly to your right, adjacent to the Lift on the east side
directions.ladies-common-room:
i. Stairs-1: Turn left; the Ladies Room is on your left, directly below the Washroom near the Stairs-1 exit.
ii. Stairs-2: Walk north; the Ladies Room is on your left just above the mid-floor level, below the Washroom.
iii. LIFT: Turn left; the Ladies Room is on your left, directly beside the Lift on the west side.
directions.lh-308:
i. Stairs-1: Turn right and walk south a short distance; LH-308 is on your right, below LH-310.
ii. Stairs-2: Walk north and turn right; LH-308 is on your right in the mid-east section of the floor.
iii. LIFT: Turn right and walk south slightly; LH-308 is on your right just below the Lift level.
directions.lh-306:
i. Stairs-1: Turn right and walk south past LH-308; LH-306 is further down on your right in the lower-east section.
ii. Stairs-2: Turn left and walk north slightly; LH-306 is on your right on the east side, near the south end.
iii. LIFT: Turn right and walk south past LH-308; LH-306 is on your right further south.
directions.texas-instruments:
i. Stairs-1: Turn left and walk south past the Lift and Ladies Room; the lab is on your left in the lower section, above Stairs-2.
ii. Stairs-2: Turn right; the lab is immediately on your left, just above Stairs-2.
iii. LIFT: Turn left and walk south; the lab is on your left near the bottom of the floor, just above Stairs-2.
directions.apj-third-way-ramanujan: Connecting corridor/bridge on the bottom right leading to Ramanujan Block.
